_comment: Per-million-token USD rates for the pre-call cost estimate, the usage ledger and the platform key's meter. `make sync-pricing` updates `models` from LiteLLM's price listing, and the weekly pricing workflow opens a pull request when it changes: review it before merging, since these rates meter real money. A model not here falls back to `unknown_model_rate`, a deliberately high guess the UI labels as one. Every model Settings suggests must be here.

token_counting._comment: estimate_tokens: characters of Chinese, Japanese and Korean script count tokens_per_cjk_char each; everything else chars_per_token characters to a token. Tune from `make platform-ai-usage`, which compares estimates with what providers reported.
